name: tcms-packages
description: Workspace root for the TypeScript packages that talk to the TCMS API. Deliberately NOT at the repository root: the root runs docker compose and nothing else (CLAUDE.md), and backend/ and frontend/ are independent stacks that must keep building on their own. This root has no build of its own either — it exists so @tcms/cli and the MCP server can resolve @tcms/client without a file: dependency or a publish step between every change.
